source: CAMIL GE-V-16 · Page 32 · Animals (birds, sea and insects half)
notes: dove/pigeon (paloma) and frog/toad (rana/sapo) are collision pairs and stay together.
'chicken', 'turkey' and 'fish' also appear in Food and Ingredients as meat. Different
areas, and the double life of those words is worth a learner meeting twice.
'seal' also appears in Tools as the stamp. Same spelling, unrelated meanings, different

area.name: Birds, Sea Animals and Insects
area.nameEs: Aves, animales de mar e insectos
area.description: Las aves de corral y las salvajes, los animales del mar y del río, y los insectos que se meten en la casa.

units.name: Farm birds
units.topic: The birds kept for eggs and meat. A hen is female, a rooster male, a chicken either

units.name: Wild birds
units.topic: The birds you see in a city or in the sky. 'dove' and 'pigeon' are both paloma — a dove is smaller and paler, and stands for peace

units.name: In the water
units.topic: What lives in the sea, in rivers and at their edges. 'frog' and 'toad' are close — a toad has drier, rougher skin and stays further from water

units.name: Insects
units.topic: The insects you meet outdoors, and the one everybody likes

units.name: Pests
units.topic: The small creatures that get into a house or onto a body, and are not wanted there
